tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background behind every screen. Warm paper in light, deep night-blue in dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, tab bar, list rows.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Inputs, number keypad, segmented-control track, progress-bar track.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines (1px). Decorative only — never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Outline of secondary buttons, unchecked toggles and inputs (≥3:1 on bg and surface in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and amounts on bg, surface, surface-sunk and sunday-soft (≥14:1 light, ≥11:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: dates, captions, tax-line hints. On bg, surface, surface-sunk (≥5.3:1 both themes).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one main action per screen (Save, Sort now, Continue). Navy in light; sunshine yellow in dark.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill (14:1 light, 10:1 dark).

tokens.name: sunday
tokens.usage: Sunday accent: Sort badge, progress bar, suggested-chip ring, PRO badge border, sun illustration.

tokens.name: on-sunday
tokens.usage: Text on a sunday fill, e.g. the Sort tab count badge (9:1).

tokens.name: sunday-soft
tokens.usage: The "To sort" card, OCR-filled fields ("From receipt"), Unsorted row tint.

tokens.name: sunday-ink
tokens.usage: Text on sunday-soft and the "?" unsorted marker (7:1 both themes).

tokens.name: income
tokens.usage: Income marks: dot, icon fill, Income segment, In bar. Not for small text in light — use income-text.

tokens.name: income-text
tokens.usage: Income amounts and labels on bg/surface (≥7:1 both themes).

tokens.name: income-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind income icons and the Income segment when selected.

tokens.name: expense
tokens.usage: Expense marks: dot, icon fill, Out bar. Warm terracotta — never error red.

tokens.name: expense-text
tokens.usage: Expense amounts and labels on bg/surface (≥7:1 both themes).

tokens.name: expense-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind expense icons and the Expense segment when selected.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Real errors only: failed save, invalid sum, purchase failed. Text on bg/surface ≥5.8:1.

tokens.name: error-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an error banner.

tokens.name: work
tokens.usage: Work scope: chip fill, swipe-right background, map line for work segments.

tokens.name: work-text
tokens.usage: "Work" label text on bg/surface (≥6.4:1).

tokens.name: work-soft
tokens.usage: Work chip background when not selected.

tokens.name: personal
tokens.usage: Personal scope: chip fill, swipe-left background, greyed-violet route segment.

tokens.name: personal-text
tokens.usage: "Personal" label text on bg/surface (≥6.4:1).

tokens.name: personal-soft
tokens.usage: Personal chip background when not selected.

tokens.name: on-scope
tokens.usage: Text on a filled work or personal chip / swipe background (≥4.5:1 both themes).

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Automation status: working ("Automatic trips on", "Nightly backup on"). Dot + word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: ok-text
tokens.usage: Status text for ok (≥6:1).

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Automation status: needs attention (paused by battery saving, 3 backups failed, photos ≤3 left). Dot/icon only in light.

tokens.name: warn-text
tokens.usage: Warning text on bg/surface/warn-soft (≥5.6:1).

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a warning card on Home.

tokens.name: off
tokens.usage: Automation status: off. Dot only; label in ink-muted.

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: Recording dot on a running trip (blinks). The only red outside errors.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard / switch-access focus ring with 2px bg gap (≥3:1 on every surface).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dimmed backdrop behind sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: device
tokens.usage: Mockup only: phone bezel and widget wallpaper base. Not used inside the app.

styles.name: amount-xl
styles.usage: Number being typed in Quick capture and Entry detail (spec 48–64sp). Tabular figures.

styles.name: amount-lg
styles.usage: Hero totals: Sort card amount, active trip miles, Reports profit.

styles.name: amount-md
styles.usage: Totals inside cards (This week, Miles summary).

styles.name: amount-row
styles.usage: Amount at the end of a list row.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: No category needed — you'll sort it on Sunday.
styles.usage: All running text. Never below 16px for body copy.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Row metadata, chip text, tab labels (13–14).

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase badges (PRO, AUTO) and section labels in Settings.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside chips and badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips; badge padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked cards; row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side margin and card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding for hero cards (This week, Sort card).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section spacing; sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Onboarding vertical rhythm; empty-state spacing.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for every control.

tokens.name: tap-main
tokens.usage: Main buttons, round capture buttons (Photo, Work, Note).

tokens.name: tap-hero
tokens.usage: The two Home capture buttons (− Expense, + Income).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, small thumbnails, inputs inside cards.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, list groups, keypad keys.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Every card and widget tile.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Main buttons (pill), 56px tall → fully round ends.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Chips, dots, round buttons, toggles.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards resting on bg. Barely there.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: FAB, snackbar, the top Sort card, bottom sheets.
